goal: Ensure address queries return the requested quota even when many peers are banned or discouraged
Avoids leaking banlist size to network peers via underfilled address responses
reviewability: Author has been silent for 83 days and may not respond promptly to review
agreement: Blocking objection: predicate design is overengineering compared to oversampling (fjahr, Bicaru20)
Concept approval for filtering during address selection (sipa, frankomosh)
Strong support because it avoids coupling address storage to ban management (mzumsande)
Unaddressed objection: retaining banned addresses in storage causes slot competition (ajtowns)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because address underfill only manifests when a node has many banned or discouraged peers
Fixing underfill stops peers inferring banlist size, but the condition is deferrable
